project.name: neo-whatsapp-connect
responsibility: Expose the internal provider contract used by neo-crm-core
Send WhatsApp messages through the configured Meta WhatsApp Cloud API credentials
Validate Meta webhook signatures when META_APP_SECRET is configured
Forward inbound message events to the configured internal webhook consumer
Expose /health for Railway and operational monitoring
not_responsible_for: Storing or exposing secrets in the frontend
Acting as source of truth for users or conversations

webhook_receive.purpose: Receive WhatsApp webhook events from Meta

from_meta.WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN: Access token used to call Meta Graph API
from_meta.WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID: Phone Number ID used in /messages endpoint
from_meta.WHATSAPP_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT_ID: WhatsApp Business Account ID from API Setup
from_meta.META_APP_SECRET: Meta app secret used to validate webhook signatures

generated_by_neo.META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN: Random verification token configured both in Meta and Railway
generated_by_neo.WEBHOOK_SECRET: Bearer secret used when forwarding inbound events internally
generated_by_neo.PROVIDER_SECRET: Bearer secret used by neo-crm-core to call /send

runtime.WEBHOOK_URL: Internal callback URL that receives normalized inbound events
runtime.GRAPH_API_VERSION: Meta Graph API version, default v25.0
runtime.DEFAULT_COUNTRY_CODE: Default phone normalization country code, default 55
runtime.DATABASE_URL: Optional PostgreSQL URL for local persistence

connection_page_role.purpose: Guide the operator through connecting the Meta WhatsApp app to neo-whatsapp-connect
must_display_to_operator: Callback URL to paste in Meta Webhooks
Verify token to paste in Meta Webhooks
must_not_do: Use temporary access token as production credential
Send test messages without explicit operator action

degraded_mode.description: Service can boot without operational WhatsApp secrets so Railway healthcheck passes
